summary: Granite County, MT 1930s patrol tower and camp on the Deerlodge NF; abandoned in the 1940s; Forest Lookouts marks it Removed; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts lists the site as Removed, with no detail on what was removed; the FFLA list says Platform Abandoned; firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1940s.

evidence.supports: 1930s patrol tower and camp; abandoned in the 1940s
21 miles southwest of Phillipsburg, Granite County
listed as Platform, status Abandoned, coordinates 46.07110 north and 113.63320 west
Forest Lookouts status Removed; the page gives no detail

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com calls the structure a patrol tower; the FFLA list calls it a platform. The brief keeps platform, and the story reports both descriptions.

notes_for_editor: Three listings only. Dates are decade-only (1930s, 1940s), so no events are recorded. No staffing, access, elevation or present-day description in any source read. A 2026 'Moose Fire' in Granite County appeared in search results; no source ties it to this lookout, so it is left out. Two WebSearch calls and about four reads used.
